how: Members call for hands to build and defend their small signs.
Recruitment targets friendly audiences because publicity may also bring attackers.
Members describe the difficulty of needing more people and a bigger sign while barely sustaining a tiny presence.
A question about who began the canvas message receives an account of its origin and completion.
Tempered expectations accompany continued effort rather than a demonstrated departure under strain or repair of an internal quarrel.
Members explicitly start new signs, fitting the revised starter role without requiring evidence of followers.
One member combines beginning the LOLI logo with a direct call for help.
The local start-to-call path cannot by itself explain entry through maintaining a sign already completed by an outside group.
Members propose alternative wording and signs rather than executing one fixed original design.
Members report their background work and describe clearing tiles to rebuild.
A small-build proposal receives an explicit report of work on its pink background.
The original blueprint is circulated expressly to ease maintenance.
A maintenance blueprint does not establish that a preceding design argument was settled by posting that template.
A member advises refreshing before placing so that the displayed canvas is current.
Members exchange an originating server invite, request coordination through chat, and offer and agree to join a dedicated server.
Invitations and outside advertising instantiate limited chat involvement, while later decisions moving off Reddit remain unestablished.
A request to keep the effort going receives a brief promise and thanks.
The handoff receives an explicit short acceptance in the next turn.
A joining line explicitly credits discovering the logo, leaving the written call's independent recruiting effect unresolved.
A defender promises to return when the pixel timer is ready, making participation conditional on personal attention and availability.
Informal canvas handoffs do not establish formal command, while later SFW rules and moderator recruitment establish explicit order during transition.
Accusations about enemy alternate accounts do not establish the defending room's own scripts or spare accounts.
Defence calls and accusations about enemy alts do not show defenders adopting machine hands under strain.
Chat invitations and publicity fears do not establish hidden plans, spying, or infiltration of rival venues.
Members defer expansion until errors fall and put immediate defence before new plans.
Members propose changing artwork and lettering to resist hostile alterations while disputing whether a larger sign can be held.
The supported local maintenance account does not establish the added mechanism of unbriefed keepers repairing away an agreed design change.
Members identify alleged griefing accounts and correct attribution by naming Moroccan users.
An inherited completed sign and repeated rebuilding require entry at upkeep and further building rounds rather than one local first-build-to-maintenance passage.
Neighbours request pixel adjustments, state free space, and receive an explicit change of plan.
A member accepts moving construction so a neighbour's M can remain.
Members refuse retaliation and ask attackers to respect the sign.
Before loss must refer to the current build, because preventive spot adjustment also occurs while rebuilding after earlier destruction elsewhere.
Border talk can prevent prospective interference during construction rather than require prior neighbour erosion of a maintained work.
Sparing neighbouring work can constitute the boundary settlement rather than follow an already settled border.
Protection seeking and a neighbour's limited statement of available space do not establish host rule over guests.
Neighbour negotiation and mutual-help promises do not establish that any participant belongs to both groups.
A mutual-help proposal receives an explicit promise of assistance against vandalism.
Two groups agreeing to defend each other instantiate the model's smallest coalition form.
The record supports requesting outside help against vandalism but does not verify that the requested defensive placements arrived.
Mutual defence is the proposed agreement itself, leaving a separately settled border causing later help trading unresolved.
Protection seeking and mutual promises support alliance formation under attack without verifying subsequent joint defensive placements.
A member states a limit on their own representative standing before approaching another room.
A perceived lack of mandate can stop even an initial help request before terms are proposed or accepted.
Pre-outreach hesitation does not instantiate the bounded arrow's after-agreement refusal mechanism.
Proposed diplomacy and reassurance do not by themselves demonstrate a completed envoy mission between rooms.
Members explicitly propose leaving the original location because targeted interference is ruining it.
A fresh-start proposal is followed by a reply describing tile clearing to resume writing, preserving a move-to-building return absent from the model's arrows.
The explicit move explanation names targeted interference, so accompanying doubts do not independently establish insufficient hands as its cause.
A plea that destroying the sign is impolite receives a reply that creating its message is less polite.
Members mock an opponent as secretly interested and joke that the damaged sign is already perfect.
The current dispute and jokes do not establish the historical inter-room quarrel required by this condition.
The room rallies around Flat is justice, fitting the revised range's use of fandom lore without establishing a prior organized room.
A replacement proposal and fandom slogan do not establish an attack naming a rival through a demonstrated prior tie.
Participants contest the acceptability of the sign's message when a request for respect is answered with moral condemnation.

statement: Contesting a group's right to display its message
how: The dispute extends beyond offensive jokes or covering fairness to whether a group's message should have any public canvas presence.
Members offer a dedicated chat and agree to join it while a room gathers people around their shared canvas signs.
The event room's existence and survival question do not reveal a separate host's handling of canvas talk.
Calls inside an event room do not show a host creating it in response to a flood of those calls.
Incoming brigading is not identified as members attacking their own mark because they object to canvas posts.
The coded canvas origin account does not evidence a local April Fools takeover or prank framing of this subreddit.
Defenders announce the final sign, credit tiles, and salute and thank those who maintained it.
Success claims must retain speaker and target because an earlier celebration belongs to opponents rather than the defending room.
The end announcement records the main sign's unblemished final condition.
Reporting completion and marking success can coincide in one announcement rather than constitute separate local stages.
A completion announcement already reports the final condition, leaving a distinct celebration-causes-preservation mechanism unestablished.
A final-condition report and credit do not establish correction or contest over the retained canvas or historical account.
Discovery of the visible logo brings a helper in and connects a defender who had thought they were alone.
Final credit and celebration do not show the work being presented to creators, companies, or the press for recognition.
Members propose a lasting archive companion to Discord, another event, moderation, and new content.
Continuing the community depends in participants' account on SFW content rules and building a moderation team.
A proposed future archive does not establish that an existing record caused the decision to continue the room.
Members propose converting another sign's wording, without thereby proving the conversion was completed.
Incoming brigading must retain its hostile actor rather than be attributed to the defending room whose thread records it.
Defence calls and an incoming brigade do not establish that the focal room's mobilized builders became attackers.
The local contest involves identifiable hostile participants without establishing a single rival room behind their attacks and taunts.
Refusing to stoop to incoming attackers' level does not instantiate the specified refusal of the focal room's own outgoing attack call.
A reply to the discussion of incoming alts explicitly refuses lowering the defenders' conduct to the attackers' level.
Incoming attack can continue in mockery and ironic thanks without an outgoing focal-room call or a named rival community.
A conversion proposal and later diplomacy do not establish an attack call causing border talk through an invoked truce.
